Class GodModeInterventionCoordinator

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.ui.godmode.GodModeInterventionCoordinator
public final class GodModeInterventionCoordinator extends Object
Coordinates physical event validation, immediate forcing execution, chronological scheduling, and audit trail list view synchronization for GodModePanel.
Version:
1.0.0-beta.3
Author:

  • Method Details

    • scheduleOrExecuteEvent

      public static void scheduleOrExecuteEvent(boolean immediate, GodModeEventRegistry.EventTypeItem item, String rawEventName, int spinnerTargetYear, int spinnerTargetMonth, int spinnerTargetDay, double lat, double lng, double mag, double radiusKm, int durationDays, H3SimulationEngine engine, ScenarioTimeline timeline, H3MapCanvas mapCanvas, Runnable onTimelineUpdated)
      Validates geographical compatibility, logs the event in the scenario timeline, and optionally executes immediate physical forcing on the H3 simulation mesh.
      Parameters:
      immediate - true to execute immediately at current simulation year
      item - selected event catalog item
      rawEventName - user-entered event title
      spinnerTargetYear - target year selected in spinner
      lat - epicenter latitude in degrees \([-90, +90]\)
      lng - epicenter longitude in degrees \([-180, +180]\)
      mag - perturbation magnitude
      radiusKm - spatial action radius in kilometers
      durationDays - active perturbation duration in days
      engine - active H3 simulation engine
      timeline - scenario chronological timeline
      mapCanvas - cartographic H3 canvas
      onTimelineUpdated - callback refreshing the UI timeline list

      Records a direct God Mode intervention into the world buffer, history snapshots, and timeline audit log.
      Parameters:

      timeline - scenario timeline
      type - canonical event identifier
      title - human-readable title

      lat - epicenter latitude

      onTimelineUpdated - callback refreshing the UI timeline list
